A [[Citadel Chest]] spawns when you defeat [[Mallyx the Unyielding]] in the [[Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]]. In normal mode and hard mode, it yields exactly one [[unique item]] for each party member.

==Locations==
*[[Realm of Torment]]
**[[The Ebony Citadel of Mallyx]]
